description: This file defines a utility enum 'GatewayDiscoverySelectionSupport' that provides static methods to determine and apply remote gateway selection logic based on gateway discovery data, configurations, and helper functions.

methods.name: applyRemoteSelection
methods.description: Updates the application's state with the preferred transport, remote URL, and target based on the discovered gateway, setting configuration files as needed.

methods.name: preferredTransport
methods.description: Determines the preferred transport method for the given gateway, defaulting to the current transport unless a direct connection is favored.

methods.name: shouldPreferDirectTransport
methods.description: Evaluates whether the gateway should be connected directly based on URL availability, stable ID prefix, and hostname suffix filtering.
